parts.text: Three-year postdoctoral position in the ANR–DFG 3DFaceBias project, auditing disparities in 3D facial reconstruction from 2D images, identifying causes and evaluating data-centric mitigation. Based at the Brest campus, collaborating with FAU under Sarah Matta and Tinashe Mutsvangwa. Requires strong empirical machine learning, statistics, Python/PyTorch and a relevant doctorate obtained less than three years before recruitment. The official employer page gives a 20 November 2026 deadline and 1 March 2027 start; interviews take place on a rolling basis. Indicative annual gross salary depends on profile and experience.
